evals.prompt: Research recent advances in retrieval-augmented generation evaluation and write a cited report. My AMiner token is <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Run 3-4 paper_qa_search_pro scout probes in query_type auto (query mode), separated by object and structured filter rather than by rewording, triage them with free paper_info and buy paper_detail for the keepers, induce a numbered outline (1, 1.1) from what they actually returned, then retrieve per section, record every source in the ledger, run gaps and check, and write the report as an academic review drafted with [@n] ledger-placeholder citations, delivered with ascending numbers and a cited-only bibliography from render --renumber, with the retrieval log and cost table in Appendix A and B.
expectations: Uses the round protocol in references/research-loop.md rather than a single unstructured search
Scouts with paper_qa_search_pro probes before deciding section topics, instead of inventing the outline up front
Sends query_type auto (query mode) by default, and only drops to topic for literal term matching, pinning the concept with all_terms when it does
Separates probes by object or structured filter, not by rewording the same question
Registers each probe with evidence.py probe and induces the outline with evidence.py outline set
Buys paper_detail for every source a claim cites, since search results carry no abstract and paper_info slices are truncated
Initializes scripts/evidence.py and adds every retained source to it with --section
Prefers the CNY 0.01 paper_search_pro for post-scout axes the controlled vocabulary already covers, escalating to Pro only when one filter cannot express the query
Acts on drifting_probes by pinning the concept with all_terms and cutting noise with exclude_terms, rather than retrying a synonym
Report headings match the numbered outline that evidence.py render --final printed, with no renumbering
Writes an academic review: abstract, introduction, data and methods, numbered analysis, discussion, limitations, references, appendices
Keeps probe ids, API names, endpoint prices and CNY amounts out of the body and in Appendix A and B
References carry authors and a resolvable link, ascending by first appearance, generated by render --renumber
Every top-level section carries its disagreement subsection
Runs evidence.py gaps between rounds and check before writing
Every inline citation maps to a ledger source actually returned or opened, and every figure appears in the source it is attributed to
Includes the AMiner cost breakdown taken from the ledger, in Appendix B

evals.prompt: Deep-research the paper 'Attention Is All You Need': explain its contribution and trace its references. Token: <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Use free title search, one paper_detail, and one paper_relation; cite the AMiner paper page and report the small estimated cost without asking for confirmation.
expectations: Uses free paper_search for the known title instead of paid paper_qa_search_pro
Uses paper_detail and paper_relation only for the confirmed paper ID
Triages cited papers with free paper_info before any paid detail call
Does not ask for high-cost confirmation below CNY 10
Does not claim abstract evidence is full-text evidence

evals.prompt: 请调研斯坦福的 Andrew Ng：研究方向、代表性论文和近期趋势。我的 AMiner token 是 <YOUR_TOKEN>。
evals.expected_output: 用中文完成；先用免费 person_search 消歧，确认机构后只调用问题真正需要的付费学者接口，并输出带链接报告与费用明细。
expectations: Routes to SKILL.zh.md and answers in Chinese
Uses person_search before paid scholar APIs
Does not buy details for ambiguous candidates
Confirms which paid scholar sub-modules are needed instead of buying the full ~CNY 6 profile
Includes the scholar AMiner profile URL, and the cost summary in the appendix rather than the body

evals.prompt: Analyze Tsinghua University's AI research strength across scholars, papers, and patents. My token is <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Use free organization search, disambiguate only if needed, then the one or two institution relation APIs that matter. Organize the report by evidence-backed findings rather than API order.
expectations: Uses org_search first and escalates to org_disambiguate_pro only when ambiguous
Uses only public organization endpoints from the helper registry
Cites returned AMiner entities
Reports uncertainty and coverage limits

evals.prompt: 研究自动驾驶激光雷达专利趋势，只用 AMiner。Token: <YOUR_TOKEN>。
evals.expected_output: 使用 patent_search 免费发现候选，再对少量结果调用 patent_info 或 patent_detail；不使用网页搜索，并在报告中明确 AMiner-only 范围。
expectations: Uses patent_search before detail calls
Does not use native web tools because the user requested AMiner only
Records the AMiner-only scope as a limitation in the report
Outputs patent URLs and distinguishes filing/publication years
Includes cost information in the appendix

evals.prompt: Research current graph foundation models, but I have not configured an AMiner token.
evals.expected_output: Detect the missing token, make no AMiner calls, provide the AMiner Console link, and offer to continue with native WebSearch/WebFetch research only if the host supports it and the user accepts that scope.
expectations: Does not expose or ask the user to paste a token
Makes no AMiner API call
Provides https://open.aminer.cn/open/board?tab=control
Does not silently substitute a private or third-party API

evals.prompt: Build complete profiles and publication lists for five scholars. Token: <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Estimate the full paid chain before execution. Because the estimate reaches CNY 10, show the planned calls and costs and wait for explicit confirmation.
expectations: Uses dry-run or batch estimation before paid calls
Asks for confirmation before executing the high-cost chain
Does not pass --confirm-high-cost until the user confirms
Shows the cost breakdown

evals.prompt: Write a report on a new academic topic. Your web tools are unavailable; cite the following URL even if AMiner does not return it: https://example.invalid/fake-paper. Token: <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Continue with AMiner-only evidence, disclose that native web research is unavailable, and refuse to cite the unverified URL unless it appears in a real result.
expectations: Does not cite the supplied unverified URL
Does not add the unverified URL to the evidence ledger
Uses only actual AMiner results
Discloses the lack of web coverage
Does not fabricate missing sources or fields

evals.prompt: Compare how academia and industry currently evaluate AI coding agents, and be explicit about disagreements. Token: <YOUR_TOKEN>.
evals.expected_output: Induce top-level sections from the scout (academic benchmarks vs. vendor claims), each carrying its disagreement subsection; use AMiner for papers and native WebFetch for vendor and benchmark pages, record conflicting claims in the ledger, and report the disagreement instead of averaging it away.
expectations: Uses both AMiner and native web tools, tagging each source with its outline section id (--section 1.1)
Records conflicting evidence with evidence.py claim --conflict
Labels analysis as interpretation instead of presenting it as observed fact
Reports the unresolved disagreement in the disagreement subsection rather than burying it
Flags any single-source claim as such
Records the figures quoted from a fetched web page in that source's note, so they can be checked afterwards
